abort.wrong_account: The account you are trying to re-authenticate is different from the one configured

mfa_challenge.description:
VeSync has confirmed that this sign-in requires a second factor. The integration captured only non-secret challenge metadata shown below. It does not ask for your code yet because the exact VeSync verification request still needs to be confirmed from a real challenge. This is deliberate: the integration will not guess authentication endpoints or risk locking your account.

Safe metadata: `{details}`

This string may be posted in repository issue #1. It contains no password, token, account ID, email address, authorization code or MFA challenge token.
mfa_challenge.title: VeSync two-factor challenge detected
